title: Comparing Moral Values in Western English-speaking societies and LLMs with Word Associations

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing Global Moral Networks by propagating seed values from the Moral Foundations Dictionary through LLM-generated word association graphs, and comparing the resulting moral scores for various concepts against human-generated data to identify divergences in moral reasoning and value alignment.

Evaluating the differences in conceptual word associations and moral sentiment between LLMs (which reflect statistical text patterns) and human participants specifically from Western, English-speaking societies to highlight Anglo-centric cultural and religious alignments.
